Nollywood fans are buzzing with excitement ahead of the sequel to Netflix’s original film, Jagun Jagun, following the incusion of Funke Akindele in the cast alongside Femi Adebayo. The fans have continued to celebrate the on-screen pairing of the two actors reviving interest in their previous collaborations in Yoruba films such as Taiwo Taiwo. The renewed excitement, known as “shipping”, has followed the release of promotional content featuring the actors ahead of the sequel to Netflix’s original film, Jagun Jagun. Akindele’s inclusion in the cast has sparked conversations on social media, with fans sharing behind-the-scenes pictures and videos of the pair, expressing excitement about seeing them work together again. The interest in their pairing dates back particularly to the 2008 Yoruba film Taiwo Taiwo, in which Akindele played T-Girl while Adebayo portrayed T-Boy. The characters were presented as a duo who lived seemingly ordinary lives during the day but operated a robbery syndicate at night. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources Their on-screen chemistry in the film has remained memorable among fans, many of whom have continued to call for the actors to reunite in similar roles. The conversation gained fresh attention in October after the two actors were spotted exchanging greetings at the seventh birthday celebration of actress Wunmi Toriola’s son. Videos from the event circulated online, prompting further comments about the pair. Fans also called for a remake of Taiwo Taiwo, with Akindele responding positively to the suggestion. Adebayo equally showed enthusiasm about the possibility. Bodun (@bodungirl) shared behind-the-scenes pictures from the Jagun Jagun 2 photoshoot, writing, “Where are my fellow shameless shippers FA2.. Funke Akindele & Femi Adebayo bts of Jagun Jagun2 photoshoot.” POLAN (@POLANKLASIQ) wrote on October 23, “See how Funke Akindele and femi Adebayo looks lovely in this video No ship looks loving than this”. Similarly, O’Nene (@stylishnene) wrote on October 19, “Apparently a lot of Nigerians are shipping FUNKE AKINDELE and FEMI ADEBAYO THEY ARE BOTH PARENTS OF TWINS (” Big Dams (@ade_darme) also expressed support for the pairing, writing on October 19, “they’re shipping Femi Adebayo and Funke Akindele? I’m there. my ship since 2008 I no use dem play o” Another fan, Jasper (@Talk2warith), praised the actors’ talents and expressed excitement about their pairing, writing, “Imagine Femi Adebayo and Funke Akindele rekindling their romance and eventually getting married. Nollywood would never be the same! With their combined talent, passion, creativity and business acumen, they could become the Dangotes of Nollywood. As far as I’m concerned, Femi Adebayo is the best actor in Nigeria. His versatility, creativity and ability to bring every character to life are simply outstanding. That man is exceptionally talented!” Aladire (@SistoFavored) noted that fans had given the pairing a name, writing on October 18, “Shippers of Funke Akindele and Femi Adebayo are at it again They have named it FaFa as seen today on fb Una shippers, your ship fit no sail.o, Don’t go and be having heart p@in o FaFa2026” However, some social media users urged fans to appreciate the actors’ friendship and professional interactions without reading too much into them. Lola Okunrin (@lollypeezle) cautioned fans against making assumptions about their relationship based on their public appearances, writing on October 23, “Femi Adebayo is doing what he does around Funke Akindele on a normal day and you people are screaming ‘awwn, they are so in love’ Nothing here is showing romantic relationship. Una go force two incompatible people into relationship.” Despite the differing reactions, the renewed interest in the pair has brought attention to their previous collaborations and the excitement surrounding their appearance together in the Jagun Jagun sequel.
